key_insight: V-PaSS uses physics-aware representations of perovskite alloys and device stacks to improve predictions for unfamiliar solar-cell materials and architectures.
engineering_relevance: The approach could support screening new absorber compositions and transport-layer combinations without requiring a pre-solved crystal structure for every alloy.
method: Interpolate relaxed crystal graphs of 23 pure ABX₃ endpoints using Vegard’s law and learned bandgap bowing.
Encode layer sequence, cell polarity and interfacial band offsets.
Represent chemical descriptions with a scientific language model.
evidence_signal: On institution-grouped tests using unseen laboratories, untuned V-PaSS achieved 2.861% MAE versus 3.017% for a gradient-boosted baseline, with 15.7–19.0% error reductions on unseen absorber alloys.
watch_item: Virtual-alloy interpolation assumes physical continuity; accuracy for compositions that depart from this assumption needs validation.
paper_title: Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System for extrapolative prediction of perovskite solar cells
